product.name: Pegler Yorkshire Xpress Copper Press Fit 45 Degree Male/Female Elbow
product.description: Designed to help you fit your pipes together at a 45° angle, this Xpress copper 45° press street elbow is perfect for you! With a quick and easy installation process, this fitting has a totally heat-free jointing system which means no solders, adhesives, or hot works when being applied.Not only will the clean internal bore save you time on cleaning and long preparation, but the copper structures also have no carbon deposits, internal solder, or flux residue - this lessens the risk of your street elbow corroding and increases longevity and durability. This product is ideal for domestic maintenance and refurbishment, as well as new build and large-scale public-sector projects. This product is available in varied sizes from 15mm to 108mm.

product.name: Fernox HP-EG Heat Transfer Fluid
product.description:
Fernox HP-EG Heat Transfer Fluid is a concentrated, high-performance solution manufactured for Air and Ground Source Heat Pump systems, based on ethylene glycol. This advanced fluid ensures a prolonged system lifespan by providing superior corrosion and limescale protection. Notably, it offers frost protection ranging from -10°C (25% concentration) to an impressive -33°C (50% concentration), allowing users to adjust protection levels depending on specific requirements.
Apart from its frost-resistant attributes, Fernox HP-EG enhances energy efficiency with its lower viscosity compared to propylene glycol alternatives. This results in reduced energy consumption during fluid circulation, contributing to both cost savings and environmentally conscious operations.
Features & Benefits: Fernox HP-EG Heat Transfer FluidA concentrated, high-performance fluid for Air and Ground Source Heat Pumps based on ethylene glycolWill prolong your system's lifespan with superior corrosion and limescale protectionFrost protection from -10°C to -33°C, adjustable based on concentration (25% to 50%)Enhances energy efficiency with lower viscosity, reducing fluid circulation energy consumptionOutstanding pH buffering maintains optimal pH for mixed-metal systemsSeamless compatibility with all metals and materials commonly found in heat pump systems
The fluid's outstanding pH buffering capabilities maintain an optimal pH level for mixed-metal systems, preventing corrosion and ensuring system health. Fernox HP-EG is a cost-effective solution prioritising thermal efficiency, making it a wise choice for those seeking reliable performance within budget constraints. It seamlessly works with all metals and materials commonly found in heat pump systems.
Please note: Dilute before use using mains water. Deionised water (demineralised) or artificially softened water is also suitable if preferred. To ensure adequate corrosion protection, the minimum ‘in-use’ concentration is 25%.Frost protection levels can be checked using a Fernox Refractometer. Existing heating systems should be cleaned of sludge and limescale deposits with a suitable Fernox Cleaner before adding Fernox HP-EG.

product.name: Pegler Yorkshire Xpress Copper S1S Press Slip Coupling
product.description: This Xpress copper press slip coupling is perfect for connecting copper pipes together. It uses a press tool method that doesn’t need any additional solders, adhesives, or hot works to install and utilises a slip feature that lets the fitting slide over the pipe. This means that your experience will be quick, safe, and easy without long preparation times. Not only does the clean internal bore mean less cleaning, but the copper structures also have no carbon deposits, internal solder, or flux residue – this lessens the risk of corrosion while simultaneously increasing longevity and durability. Xpress products are ideal for domestic maintenance and refurbishment, as well as new build and large-scale public-sector projects, and the systems don’t need to be ‘dry’ for effective jointing. This product is available in varied sizes from 15mm to 108mm.Features & Benefits: Pegler Yorkshire Xpress Copper S1S Press Slip CouplingNo localised annealing due to high-temperature work  Electrical continuity when jointed  Large variety of approvals including Kitemark, WRAS, and DVGW.

product.name: PS605 Bronze Thermal Circulation Valve
product.description: The PS605 Bronze Thermal Circulation Valve is a reliable and innovative solution for maintaining safe and efficient hot water circulation systems. Designed to automatically balance thermal flow and facilitate high-temperature disinfection, this valve ensures optimal system hygiene and safety. Pre-set to approximately 57°C, it effectively prevents bacterial growth within the 22-43°C range. With an automatic disinfection feature activated at water temperatures above 65°C, it provides an added layer of protection against harmful bacteria.Crafted from durable bronze and fitted with EPDM seals, the PS605 is built for long-lasting performance under a pressure rating of PN16. It features a convenient temperature selection dial, as well as isolation and drain functions for easy maintenance and operation. product.name: Lindab Magestic Half Round Galvanised Steel Downpipe Branch
product.description:
Lindab Magestic is an improved galvanised steel material for rainwater system and standing seam applications. Magestic offers the same trusted Lindab product designs with a strengthened magnesium zinc alloy coating.Galvanised steel is already the most environmentally friendly material used in rainwater systems. Magestic has a reduced impact on zinc resources and less than 25% zinc run off into soils compared to hot dipped galvanised steel. New technology has allowed the material to be developed using magnesium to create a stable barrier to protect zinc’s porous structure against corrosion factors. Salt spray tests demonstrate the highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel. Magestic has more than twenty times the corrosion resistance of hot dipped galvanised steel. Unpainted metal gutters naturally weather organically adjusting to the installation environment. Magestic settles to an attractive dark grey metallic appearance within 3-5 years after installation.
Magestic corrosion in not influenced by the chlorine content of the environment. Natural exposure tests demonstrate more than three times the corrosion resistance of standard galvanisation in marine environments. Galvanised coatings migrate to repair red rust on cuts and scratches. Magnesium is more anodic than zinc making the sacrificial properties of Magestic more active than standard galvanisation.
Features

New elite, strengthed magnesium alloy coating
Highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel
Improved performance in coastal environments
Lowest price Lindab Rainwater System
10 Year Warranty

For use wherever access is required in a straight section, this access pipe is manufactured in easy-to-handle aluminium for lasting effectiveness.
Built with the same hidden spigot joints as the rest of the range, this access pipe is available in a selection of standard colours with additional colours available on special orders.
Offering lightweight durability with up to 40 years life expectancy and very little maintenance required, this access pipe is fully compatible with GX, Aqualine and Heritage systems.

Crafted in easy-to-handle, 100% recyclable extruded aluminium, this rainwater diverter is designed to fit neatly with the Alumasc Flushjoint circular downpipe system.
Create a truly customised system with this handy extra, finished in a range of powder-coated, BBA-approved colours - or available in a plain mill finish for on-site painting.
Whether you're installing on a refurbishment project or a brand new building development, the hidden spigot joints of the Flushjoint system will deliver a modern, streamlined aesthetic.

Concealed spigots for smooth appearance – fits in with appearance of Alumasc Aqualine as a contemporary range
Compatible with Heritage, Aqualine and GX gutters
Not designed for use in underground drainage
Circular, square or rectangular pipes
Up to 40 years life expectancy
UK manufactured

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Access Pipe
product.description:
A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements

A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements

product.description: As a perfect replacement and alternative for cast iron, this textured black rectangular downpipe is ideal for both renovation and new build applications for traditionally styled buildings. From Alumasc's innovative cast aluminium Heritage rainwater system, this downpipe with ears is well-suited for advanced fast track building contracts. Ideal for both flush and projecting eaves applications, this downpipe is available in a range of lengths and is finished with a BBA certified process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings. Manufactured in the UK, this downpipe is made from recyclable, extruded aluminium. product.name: Baxi Buffer Vessel
product.description: The Baxi Buffer Vessel is a compact thermal storage unit designed to stabilise and optimise the performance of modern heating systems, particularly those using heat pumps. With a 24L or 40L capacity, it stores excess heat and releases it gradually as demand changes, helping to maintain steady system temperatures. By preventing frequent on/off cycling, it supports improved energy efficiency, smoother operation and longer heat pump lifespan.Built for practicality, the vessel includes multiple sensor pockets for easy integration and a built-in thermometer for straightforward system monitoring. Its compact, easy-install design makes it ideal where additional system volume is required to enhance heat pump performance. Strong and durable, Deepstyle 170mm is manufactured from UV resistant PVC. product.name: DeWalt Newark Brown Waterproof Safety Boot
product.description: The high-quality full-grain black leather Newark Black Waterproof Safety Boot from DeWalt is an excellent solution for those jobs that require you to be outside working in all weathers. As well as water resistance, the boot provides exceptional comfort, protection and grip.Featuring a waterproof and breathable Samsung membrane lining, your feet will be kept dry when working in sudden rain showers or general damp conditions. The heel support system and cleated dual-density outsole, made from flexible and abrasion-resistant Thermoplastic Polyurethane (TPU), ensure excellent support and grip.Features & Benefits: DeWalt Newark Brown Waterproof Safety BootA high-quality, water-resistant full-grain black leather safety bootS3 safety ratingProvides exceptional comfort, protection and gripWaterproof and breathable Samsung membrane liningTPU heel support system and cleated dual-density outsole200-joule steel top cap and anti-scuff toe guardSteel midsole to protect against objects puncturing the solePU comfort insole and a thick padded tongue and collarAvailable in various sizesThe safety boot has a 200-joule steel top cap to protect your toes from heavy loads and an anti-scuff toe guard. A protective steel midsole will also protect your feet from objects puncturing the sole and causing potential injury. While safety is always at the forefront, comfort when working is equally important. DeWalt has designed the Newark Black Safety Boot with a PU comfort insole for the soles of your feet and a thick padded tongue and collar that will cushion your ankles.Standards & CertificationEuropean Standard: EN 20345: 2011 S3Slip Resistance: SRCPlease note: This footwear has been tested on clay tiles with a sodium lauryl sulphate solution and meets a minimum Coefficient of Friction (CoF) of 0.32 tested flat and a CoF of 0.28 when tested at the heel.This footwear is also tested on stainless steel with a glycerol solution and meets a CoF of 0.18 when tested flat and 0.13 at the heel.

product.name: Hudson Reed Chrome Triple Thermostatic Shower Valve
product.description: Complete your contemporary bathroom look with this minimalist sleek triple shower valve from Hudson Reed. Made from high-quality brass and ABS (Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene, a sturdy, toxin-free thermoplastic polymer resistant to strong impacts), it can be installed either horizontally or vertically to suit your overall décor. It provides highly accurate flow control and features thermostatic control to within +/- 2 to 3°C regardless of pressure fluctuations.And that's not all. Since the cartridge is fully reversible, it doesn't require re-plumbing even if hot and cold supplies are accidentally the wrong way around. All you have to do is remove it, turn 180° and replace! product.name: Armaflex Pipe Insulation - 2m Lengths
product.description: This Class O Armaflex pipe insulation from Armacell is manufactured from nitrile rubber to provide insulation for pipes for a range of applications. You can fit this pipe insulation as you install pipes for hot and cold water services, chilled water lines, ductwork, refrigerated pipework, and more. This Armaflex pipe insulation is flexible yet durable so easy to slip over pipes quickly without the worry of damaging the insulation or the pipes. It reduces frost on pipes, conserves energy and also controls levels of condensation so you can save money on bills and on repair work that might stem from frost or condensation damages. Dust and fibre free, during the manufacturing process a vapour barrier is built into this pipe insulation for extra energy conservation.Features & Benefits: Armaflex Pipe Insulation - 2m LengthsMade from foamed nitrile rubber with a vapour barrierPrevents frost on pipes, condensation and energy lossDust and fibre-freeThe excellent fire safety performance of this pipe insulation product has demonstrated a zero surface spread of flame and so it is recommended to combat thermal bridging. It also incorporates some acoustic insulation benefits by reducing the noise of water and air travelling through pipes. This Armaflex pipe insulation comes in 2m lengths however a range of pipe sizes and wall thicknesses are offered to get the best system for you.

product.name: Geberit Mapress Copper Slip Coupling
product.description: The Geberit 'Mapress' system of fittings is a versatile, reliable, and time-saving solution for all sorts of plumbing applications. product.name: Geberit Mapress Copper Male Adaptor
product.description: The Geberit 'Mapress' system of fittings is a versatile, reliable, and time-saving solution for a wide range of plumbing applications. The pressing procedure for these couplings is around twice as fast as soldering, with no open flames required, using cold deformation of both the fitting and the pipe itself. Each coupling has clear pressing indicators for fuss-free installation with your tools, with a huge variety of fittings available too. product.name: Geberit Mapress Copper Female Adaptor
product.description: This copper female iron adapter uses a simple pressing system that is adaptable to a variety of applications. This Geberit copper fitting can be combined with other Gerberit Supply Systems and is made from a Cu-DHP alloy (phosphorus-deoxidised copper). It contains a white pressing indicator to test if the fitting is pressed correctly and a protection plug that prevents the fittings from becoming dirty. product.name: Rubaflex Class O Nitrile Pipe Insulation 2m Lengths Full Box - 32mm
product.description:
Rubaflex pipe insulation is made from an elastomeric foam that is coated with a black polymeric surface to make it tougher and more durable in outdoor applications. UV stable and waterproof, the pipe insulation is ideal for outdoor pipes as well as for refrigeration systems, air conditioning unit pipes, ducting, and civil and industrial heating and plumbing.
Perfect for frost protection in outdoor applications, Rubaflex pipe insulation is certified to EN 14304 and meets UK Class 0 building regulations. It is an incredibly popular product throughout Europe and there are more pipe insulation thicknesses available on request from 6mm up to 32mm. Each thickness and length of Rubaflex pipe insulation is split for easy installation and retrofit capabilities. Each length of pipe insulation is 2m long.
This pipe insulation will perform at temperatures between -45° and +110° and at a mean temperature of 0° it will give you thermal conductivity of 0.036 W/mK.

product.description: This NABIC 500 high lift safety valve has been designed primarily for use on unvented hot water heating systems where a high capacity, emergency steam relief capability is required. All wetted parts are manufactured from dezincification resistance materials. Designed and tested to BS EN ISO 4126-1 and WRAS approved (1 bar and above), this safety valve is available in a wide range of sizes and has a resilient PTFE seating design with a high degree of seat tightness. Ensuring easy inspection and cleaning, it has diaphragm protected parts and a locked and sealed pressure seating. product.name: Nabic 1 1/2 inch 500 High Lift Safety Valve
product.description: This NABIC 500 high lift safety valve has been designed primarily for use on unvented hot water heating systems where a high capacity, emergency steam relief capability is required. All wetted parts are manufactured from dezincification resistance materials. Designed and tested to BS EN ISO 4126-1 and WRAS approved (1 bar and above), this safety valve is available in a wide range of sizes and has a resilient PTFE seating design with a high degree of seat tightness. Ensuring easy inspection and cleaning, it has diaphragm-protected parts and a locked and sealed pressure seating. product.name: Ideal Evo S Commercial Natural Gas Boiler
product.description: This Evo S Commercial Boiler Natural Gas is manufactured by Ideal Commercial Boilers and available in multiple outputs. Blending innovative stainless steel heater exchange technology with easy maintenance thanks to release internal water and gas couplings, it has an amazing net efficiency of up to 108.9% net efficiency when fully condensing. The boiler can be installed either on the wall or into a prefabricated floor-mounted frame, with at least a low-loss header as part of the system.This boiler is very user-friendly, with a simple controls interface with a large backlit display including integrated sequence control. product.name: 2 Multiline Cascade Kits
product.description: These Multiline Cascade Kits from Ideal Commercial Boilers are designed to streamline the installation process for up to six Evomax 2 boilers in a cascade configuration, with a combined capacity of up to 600kW. These kits are available in both starter and extension packs, providing a convenient solution for connecting Evomax 2 boilers that are installed as part of an open flue system through a common flue header. product.name: Ideal Imax Xtra 2 Condensing Commercial Boiler
product.description: This high-performance Ideal Imax Xtra 2 Condensing Commercial Boiler comes in a compact size for its class. It features a cast aluminium silicon alloy heat exchanger which has a 5-year warranty. With an amazing fully condensing 97.7% full load efficiency, it also has a high 5:1 turndown for tighter fuel control and comes with 80kW to 200kW output options.
